primarySources.role: Exact native publication Year/Date aliases and obsolete month-role boundaries.
Native named citation argument trimming preserves supplied scalar metadata precision; no day is inferred.
Whitelist acceptance is kept distinct from active obsolete Month rendering.

newAuthority: Only ASCII space, tab, CR and LF around an otherwise complete four-digit year, one complete month token/range, or the complete year-first English-month scalar. Internal CR/LF, non-ASCII whitespace, controls, comments and dynamic values remain outside the grammar.
byteContract: The exact retained Year/scalar leading and trailing bytes remain in the replacement. Removing the unique obsolete Month field removes that entire field as one already-declared repair. Every other field, delimiter and supplied year/month precision remains exact.
